verified: The API executes the orchestration engine instead of emitting fixed synthetic durations.
Executed steps receive unique step-run and tool-call identifiers.
A failed, waiting or blocked node prevents downstream tool execution.
Blender unavailability is represented as a real BLOCKED result.
limitations: Several agents are deterministic in-process tool adapters rather than isolated external agent workers.
Paperclip task synchronization and external agent observability are not verified.
